description: Source code for FFmpeg demuxer implementation, including functions for initialization, seeking, configuration retrieval, and creation/destruction of demuxer objects within the starboard shared ffmpeg namespace.

classes.name: FFmpegDemuxer
classes.description: Class implementing the FFmpeg demuxer functionality, including static methods for dispatch retrieval and test dispatch setting.

methods.name: FFmpegDemuxer_Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified timestamp in microseconds.

methods.name: FFmpegDemuxer_GetStartTime
methods.description: Retrieves the start time of the media.

methods.name: FFmpegDemuxer_Read
methods.description: Reads data from the demuxer stream.

methods.name: FFmpegDemuxer_GetAudioConfig
methods.description: Gets the audio configuration if available.

methods.name: FFmpegDemuxer_GetVideoConfig
methods.description: Gets the video configuration if available.

methods.name: FFmpegDemuxer_GetDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the media.

methods.name: CreateFFmpegDemuxer
methods.description: Creates a new FFmpeg demuxer instance.

methods.name: FFmpegDemuxer::GetDispatch
methods.description: Retrieves the current dispatch instance, or a test dispatch if set.

methods.name: FFmpegDemuxer::TestOnlySetFFmpegDispatch
methods.description: Sets a test dispatch for unit testing purposes.
